text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin wasn't feeling well, so I 
brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I'll get plenty of rest and 
bounce right back!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nnh... Huh...? City-san... where are we?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san, Palmer-san, and even 
Helios-san are all here...

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Host
text_block_list.text:
Oho, it seems our final contestant has 
awakened! Then let us begin— the "City 
Girl" Royale!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wha-whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Host
text_block_list.text:
I will have all of you compete to 
determine who is most worthy of being 
called a "City Girl."

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Host
text_block_list.text:
“The winner will receive the highest 
honor— the title of ‘Wicked Awesome City 
Girl’!”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. If it's about being a "City Girl," 
then the winner's gotta be me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Jordan! With the killer victory nails I 
got done for today, I'm gonna show you 
what gal pride is all about!

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text: We won't lose either, let's gooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Here I go! An active model's flawless 
posing! It deals damage to the opponent, 
transforming the field into a runway...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No problem! UV cut cream to cut down the 
damage! And my special nail art is gonna 
kick off a max-hype combo too, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"We've got combos of our own! Let's go, 
Helios!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: K! Time to drop a precious BFF two-shot☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawawa...! I don't really get what's 
goin' on, but everyone's amazin'...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I wanna become one too... A "wicked 
awesome city girl"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"My own weapon... Please, I'm beggin' ya, 
come to me...!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—There... Wait, s-setta sandals!? Why'd 
something like that come out!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... We ain't in the snow, so what'm I 
supposed to do!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"No, think! What would a 'city girl' do at 
a time like this...?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Just now, City-san turned the field into 
her runway— a place that works to her 
advantage. Then, I will too—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll put on my setta sandals and turn this 
whole field into a winter wonderland, by 
golly!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Kh...! My body's shaking so much, I'm 
losing my pose...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
In a snowy mountain, this nail polish 
color doesn't match at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I-It's so cold I can't hold my phone...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally~!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Cold like this is nothing for someone 
raised in snow country! My setta sandals 
go great with snowy mountains! And I can 
take all the selfies I want!"

text_block_list.name: City Girls
text_block_list.text: A-Aw, shucks, you got me~!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gasp! ...Was it a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still... one day, just like in my dreams, 
I wanna become an awesome "city girl"~!

Yukino Bijin looked refreshed, and her 
physical condition had made a full 
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Isn't it going to be hard to walk 
in that outfit? I'll lend you my heels.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That really is too pitiful. Want to use my 
nail polish too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yukino, wanna take a photo together too? 
I'm sure it'll fix your mental breakdown!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally~!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone's so nice, it's dazzling... Is 
this the radiance of a "City Girl"...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that, I'm just... I really am 
just a country bumpkin...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, was it a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just a dream... it still 
really stings, y'know. I've gotta train 
hard and polish myself up so I never lose 
no matter what situation I'm in...

Perhaps due to being troubled by 
nightmares, Yukino Bijin couldn't seem to 
shake off her physical fatigue.
